_comment: The wiki pages that price the player's wardrobe.
The game files name all 384 cosmetics and say which stall stocks each one,
but price only 26 of them — the rest are priced by compiled game code. These
three pages are the only published source for the other prices, and they also
carry two facts the files do not: how many colours a garment comes in, and a
NO SHAPE IS DECLARED, ON PURPOSE. These tables do not agree on a column
count: Clothes runs six wide and Body four, and Accessories mixes them —
seventeen of its rows drop the 'Part of a Set?' column outright. So the
parser reads cells by content (a price is what holds {{Price}}, a colour
count is a bare number, a vendor is what holds a source icon) rather than
by position, which is also what stops a reordered column from turning a
STALENESS. Both wide pages are stamped v0.14.2, so a 1.0 cosmetic exists in
the game files and not here — it ships named, slotted and stocked, with a
price gap, which is the honest state rather than an invented number.
Checked live 2026-08-08: 340 distinct rows, 128 priced. Vera's 24 hairstyles
are all on the Body page and all priced; Louis 32 of 33; Wheedle 22 of 22.
